pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HEY MONGREL! I'LL GIVE YA 100 YEN IF YA EAT THIS CIGARETTE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF ANOTHER DEVIL SHOWS UP, WE'LL CALL YOU. TRY TO RUN AND YOU'LL BE SLEEPING WITH THE FISHES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS’LL COVER ANOTHER 3 DAYS OF FOOD!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE OTHER DAY I HEARD, THAT PEOPLE NORMALLY EAT BREAD WITH JAM SPREAD ALL OVER IT.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: WELL, NORMALITY’S JUST A DREAM FOR HS THOUGH.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: I DOUBT I'LL PAY OFF THIS DEBT BEFORE I DIE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...I'M GONNA DIE SINGLE AREN'T I? NOT LIKE I COULD BRING A GIRL BACK TO THIS SHITSHACK, DON'T HAVE THE CASH TO BE DATIN' EITHER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF I COULD GET ANY WISH GRANTED, I’D WANNA BE WITH A GIRL BEFORE I DIE...
